name: whycode-vscode
description: Cleans up AI-written code: adds comments that explain what it does and why, checked so they can't change the code, and formats it with the project's own formatter.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: WhyCode runs your project's formatters, which read config files that can run code from the workspace.

virtualWorkspaces.description: WhyCode reads and writes files on disk.

enumDescriptions: A summary above each function and class, plus comments on non-obvious decisions.
Light, plus a short note for each logical block inside functions.
Near line-by-line explanations, for people learning the code or the language.
whycode.commentLevel.markdownDescription: How many comments WhyCode adds. When you set it, it overrides `commentLevel` in `.whycoderc.json`; when you don't, the file's value is used (`light` if there is none).

enumDescriptions: A VS Code language model when one is available (Claude preferred), otherwise the API key provider from .whycoderc.json (Anthropic by default).
Always a VS Code language model, such as one from GitHub Copilot (Claude preferred).
The Anthropic API, with the key from the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable.
Claude through OpenRouter, with the key from the OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable.
whycode.provider.markdownDescription: Which AI WhyCode asks for comments. API keys are read only from the environment VS Code was started with, and never stored.
